data.name: medium
text:
wellbore_instability (medium)
page: NKT-002_DDR_2025-10-21.pdf#p1
cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Alluvium, oversized cuttings at surface.
remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.
NPT: 2.48 h

data.name: high
text:
cementing_issue (high)
page: NKT-002_DDR_2025-10-21.pdf#p1
cause: Excessive cement losses to formation while cementing across Girujan.
remedy: Staged cement job with lightweight lead slurry and full tail string.
NPT: 21.59 h

overpressure (high)
page: NKT-002_DDR_2025-10-24.pdf#p1
cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.
remedy: Raised mud weight in 58-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.
NPT: 12.9 h

page: NKT-002_DDR_2025-10-25.pdf#p1
cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.

kick (high)
page: NKT-002_DDR_2025-10-27.pdf#p1
cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 63 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Kopili.
remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.
NPT: 11.08 h

mud_loss (high)
page: NKT-002_DDR_2025-10-27.pdf#p1
cause: Lost circulation 41 bbl/hr while drilling Sylhet sand, partial returns only.
remedy: Pumped 51 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.
NPT: 20.7 h

data.name: critical
text:
stuck_pipe (critical)
page: NKT-002_DDR_2025-10-25.pdf#p1
cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Barail, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stick.
remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 71 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 25.1 hrs.
NPT: 25.08 h
